What do you think of Jessica?
How do you feel about Ben and Denni?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Just... Just watch out, okay? I think some girls might have their eyes on Ben...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Wait, that's what this has been about? Why didn't you just say so?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I wasn't sure how to tell you...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Here's how... 'Hey, Denni! I think some girls are after your guy!'

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Whoa... Relax...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Sorry... I guess this is a sore spot for me.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Thanks for the heads up...
Jessica has failed.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm concerned too, actually.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Uh... About what?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I thought Ben's secret was safe, but based on your questions I know we haven't been careful enough...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You mean Ben really is... A... A...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yes, a werewolf!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But he doesn't even have a six-pack!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I started to get suspicious when I noticed how many haircuts he was getting...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Once I knew, I had to dump him...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But... You didn't...
Jessica inches away from Denni, toward the door...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But then I started to recognize changes in `my` behavior...
nodes.text_bbcode: But then I started to recognize changes in [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] behavior...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: A distaste for garlic, cravings for blood... And I got way too brooding for my own good.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's, like, totes interesting, but I think the girls need me...
Jessica takes another step toward the door.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You're not going anywhere!
In a flash, Denni suddenly stands between Jessica and the door, blocking her!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Have you ever thought about trying out for cheerleading? You're like `so` toned!
nodes.text_bbcode: Have you ever thought about trying out for cheerleading? You're like [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] toned!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's too late for pleasantries, Jessica!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Why don't you spare me? We can set up a system! You can feed on `all` the cheerleaders!
nodes.text_bbcode: Why don't you spare me? We can set up a system! You can feed on [color=#3b78e2][i]all[/i][/color] the cheerleaders!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: A great idea!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Phew!
Denni takes a menacing step toward Jessica!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But I haven't had lunch yet!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You're a vegetarian!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I make exceptions for nosy cheerleaders!
Denni leaps at Jessica!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `EEEP!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]EEEP![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Jessica has failed.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah, but your questions were all over the place! What are you asking me?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Why are you asking me all these questions?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm concerned for you, Denni...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Did someone say that?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Cause Ben's kisses are top-notch!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No... I mean... No, I don't. Not really... No...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Okay, maybe a little!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I mean, I'm not exactly the stereotypical girly-girl type that a lot of guys desire, you know?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: The taste of blood?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah, or have you ever had, like, a `craving` for blood?
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, or have you ever had, like, a [color=#3b78e2][i]craving[/i][/color] for blood?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah! All the time! That's all I want! Blood blood blood!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No! Are you insane?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What about you? Do you...

options.label: Think he kisses like a dead fish?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Uh... I think we're up to over 2,020 kisses according to the last time I checked his spreadsheet.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ew... And ew again.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: He's friendly! He smiles!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I know he does, Denni, but there's smiling like this...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And then there's smiling like this...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I don't know what kind of smiles he gives other girls, I just know the kind he gives me!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Take it easy... It's probably nothing...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You want to know if Ben howls?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Or scratches himself a lot...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Do you think he's diseased or something?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Just... Please. I'll explain soon.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: He's a guy. He scratches himself from time to time... But I've never heard him, uh, howl.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Does he ever...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What? That's a weird question.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Humor me.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I haven't, okay? Usually my eyes are closed. Why?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's just... It doesn't seem like he's into kissing you...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Really? Cause it certainly `feels` like he's into it!
nodes.text_bbcode: Really? Cause it certainly [color=#3b78e2][i]feels[/i][/color] like he's into it!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ew, never mind that.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well, usually we're alone together...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm just saying that he's cooler than he used to be. I've heard some girls call him cute.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: So what? He's a cute guy.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That doesn't bother me... Much.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh, I totes understand...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Like, when the moon is full, does he suddenly excuse himself or go on a vacation?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What are you implying?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Never mind. I'm being silly. But...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Whatev! You'll have to do better if you're going to be my number two!
Jessica takes a deep breath and steps into the bathroom. Denni is cleaning her shirt in the sink.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hey, Denni...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I saw Nicole drop that milkshake on you on purpose. I'll make sure she pays for that in cheerleading practice!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You don't have to do that...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But I want to!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Did you come here just to tell me that?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Actually, I wanted to ask you something about Ben...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Really? What?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Why would Denni dump Ben? Lack of passion? Insecurity? Or because one or both of them are... Mythological creatures?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Um, have you ever seen him...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: What?! But you said...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ugh! I was being nice!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Werewolves and vampires?! What's next? A love story about mummies and jackalopes?!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Ha! Jackalope's a funny word!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Glad to see at least one of you is cool!
Hannah and Zach walk away...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Thanks for being two-faced, Jessica!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hey, as head cheerleader, I have to protect my reputation above all else!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I can't be the symbol of popularity `and` read vampire romance books!
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't be the symbol of popularity [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] read vampire romance books!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I guess that's true...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Maybe next time you decide to share something embarrassing, keep your voice down!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Jessica? You too?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Ha ha! Why would you admit to being not cool?!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I guess the cheerleaders aren't what I thought they were... They kiss nerds, they read vampire romance books...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: I bet they dress up like their favorite characters!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Probably!
Hannah and Zach walk away laughing!
Jessica turns to Nicole!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Don't set me up like that ever again! I have a reputation to protect!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Denni and I are in a really solid place right now!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I `love` her! Don't worry, I'll never break up with her!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#e23b3b][i]love[/i][/color] her! Don't worry, I'll never break up with her!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That is really, really...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: ...`Great` to hear!
nodes.text_bbcode: ...[color=#3b78e2][i]Great[/i][/color] to hear!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It sounds like even if someone `wanted` to break you two up, it would be, like, totally impossible!
nodes.text_bbcode: It sounds like even if someone [color=#3b78e2][i]wanted[/i][/color] to break you two up, it would be, like, totally impossible!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's... A really weird way of putting it, but yeah! We're inseparable! Nothing could ever make me break up with Denni!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm super glad to hear it...
A few minutes later, Jessica and Nicole are standing outside the girls' restroom.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: What are we doing? I haven't eaten my lunch yet!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm going to go talk to Denni. She's probably cleaning up in the restroom...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I thought the plan was to get `Ben` to dump `Denni...`
nodes.text_bbcode: I thought the plan was to get [color=#3b78e2][i]Ben[/i][/color] to dump [color=#3b78e2][i]Denni...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It was, but Ben's head-over-heels for Denni. He's never going to dump her...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: ...So I'm going to find a way to get `her` to dump `him` instead!
nodes.text_bbcode: ...So I'm going to find a way to get [color=#3b78e2][i]her[/i][/color] to dump [color=#3b78e2][i]him[/i][/color] instead!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: All I need to do is find Denni's weakness... Which shouldn't be hard at all...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Yeah, only someone pathetic would highlight her hair like that!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Heh. That was `very` hench-girl!
nodes.text_bbcode: Heh. That was [color=#3b78e2][i]very[/i][/color] hench-girl!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: So... How are you going to find her weakness?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No probs! I'll just casually bring up some of the different reasons girls break up with guys...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Like... Um...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Oh! I'll totally dump a guy if he makes out weird! Just last week I dumped a guy because he kissed like a dead fish!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Lack of passion, that's a good one!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh! And girls like Denni are always dumping their bf's because they're so insecure...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I know! So many girls have dumped their perfectly good boyfriends just because `I` started talking to them!
nodes.text_bbcode: I know! So many girls have dumped their perfectly good boyfriends just because [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] started talking to them!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: And flirting with them...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: And making out with them...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Are there any other good reasons girls dump guys?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Well, don't laugh... But I read this book over the summer about a girl who dumps a guy because she thinks he's a werewolf!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh my gosh! I read that too! It was amazing!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I loved how at the end `she` was actually a vampire, but she didn't even know it!
nodes.text_bbcode: I loved how at the end [color=#3b78e2][i]she[/i][/color] was actually a vampire, but she didn't even know it!

nodes.text: Hannah and Zach overhear Nicole as they walk by...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You read `those` books, Nicole?! What are you, a middle-schooler?
nodes.text_bbcode: You read [color=#3b78e2][i]those[/i][/color] books, Nicole?! What are you, a middle-schooler?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Ha! Middle-schoolers are lame because they believe in reading!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Those books are great, okay?! Back me up, Jessica!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Uh... Those books are...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What? There's no way!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The only guy people might think she'd go for is Colt, and I know that she's over him! Unless...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh! Ha ha ha! You really got me with that one, Jessica! I thought you were serious for a second there!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Uh, yeah... Ha ha.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: She is? What is she worried about?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: She's worried that with all your newfound popularity, you're going to forget about her!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Personally, I think it's great that you've changed into this really cool guy, but that's just my opinion.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I had no idea! She never said anything!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Girls can be like that sometimes, Ben. You have to be careful. I mean, do you really `know` Denni?
nodes.text_bbcode: Girls can be like that sometimes, Ben. You have to be careful. I mean, do you really [color=#3b78e2][i]know[/i][/color] Denni?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Of course I do!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Me?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You're the perfect hench-girl...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You've stolen the most boyfriends, been sent home every other week for dress code violations, and you've always secretly wanted to be popular...

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: She doesn't care about being popular!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Actually, Jill, I do.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I thought... I thought you cared about being an athlete!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ew. No. That's just because I never thought I could be popular again!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, now's your chance!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: And I'm taking it.
Nicole walks over to Denni... And spills an entire milkshake in her lap!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Oops. You're so short, I didn't see you there.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Next time I'll try to be taller.
Denni rushes off to the restroom, and Nicole returns to Jessica's table.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: That was more fun than I thought!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Nice work, Nicole. Looks like I've got a new number two cheerleader!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Now all I have to do is get Ben to break up with Denni!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: This is `so` easy! I'll be First Lady before the end of the day!
nodes.text_bbcode: This is [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] easy! I'll be First Lady before the end of the day!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Okay!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: This is your chance to prove yourself to me...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You could become the second most popular girl in school, if you do a little dirty work...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I `hate` dirt!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]hate[/i][/color] dirt!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: That's why I vacuum Hector every time he comes over!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It's more fun than it sounds!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: The point is... Go do something to Denni. `Now!`
nodes.text_bbcode: The point is... Go do something to Denni. [color=#3b78e2][i]Now![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Sure!
Amanda walks up to Denni. They talk for a while...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What's taking her so long? Maria! You go check in on things.
Maria walks over and sits next to Denni. They start talking...
And talking...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What the...?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Jill! Keith! Hector! Nicole! Go do something!
All of the other cheerleaders sit with Denni. Soon, they're all talking and laughing!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's `it!` If you want something done right, you've got to do it yourself.
nodes.text_bbcode: That's [color=#3b78e2][i]it![/i][/color] If you want something done right, you've got to do it yourself.

nodes.text: Jessica walks over...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: ...`Orange` you glad I didn't say `'banana?'`
nodes.text_bbcode: ...[color=#3b78e2][i]Orange[/i][/color] you glad I didn't say [color=#3b78e2][i]'banana?'[/i][/color]

nodes.text: The table explodes in laughter.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oranges and bananas are both fruits!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You know so many great jokes!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What's going on here?!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I haven't felt so `cheer`ful in a long time! I'm starting to think that we chose the wrong leader.
nodes.text_bbcode: I haven't felt so [color=#e23b3b][i]cheer[/i][/color]ful in a long time! I'm starting to think that we chose the wrong leader.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Wait... What are you saying?
A few months later...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: This is Erik Ericson reporting live from the Centerscore High Voting Center, where Ben Kale has just won in a landslide victory!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I couldn't have done it without my awesome First Lady... Denni! As the new `Head Cheerleader,` she really helped me win the popular vote!
nodes.text_bbcode: I couldn't have done it without my awesome First Lady... Denni! As the new [color=#e23b3b][i]Head Cheerleader,[/i][/color] she really helped me win the popular vote!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It was nothing.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Denni, to thank you for all your hard work on behalf of my campaign... Here's a $1,000 gift card to the Centerscore Mall!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Wow! I'm going to spend it all on pre-ripped jeans!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `NOOOOOOOOOOOOO!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]NOOOOOOOOOOOOO![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Quiet down. The announcements are starting!
Justin and Erik appear on the TV screen.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'm happy to announce that we've raised over $12,000 to help feed the poor this Thanksgiving!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's all thanks to President Justin! He's a hero!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Let's cut to a tribute video I made for him!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I... Don't think that will be necessary.
Suddenly, the feed cuts to Erik's video...
'Justin. Giving Thanks for His... Giving.'
Justin stands next to Lisa on the red carpet outside a movie premiere.

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: ...And I'd just like to announce that we're giving five percent of the profits to Justin's charity! Go Lizards!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: By the way, thanks for giving me a pair of tickets, Lisa. I know it's the hottest movie of the summer and that everyone wanted to see it.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: That's why I auctioned them off to the highest bidder and gave the money to charity!

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: Oh... And who won the auction?

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: We're at the movies! So many pretty girls here!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: What's up, y'all?! Hey... You're hot!

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: I carry pepper spray.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `I` should have been on that red carpet!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] should have been on that red carpet!

nodes.text: A new image appears on the TV. Justin stands with Hawk Gunner at the top of a mountain.

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Hawk is going to do this flip for charity! Hawk-ah!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Justin got to meet `Hawk Gunner?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Justin got to meet [color=#3b78e2][i]Hawk Gunner?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I'd hook up with one of Hawk's bros just to be nearer to Hawk!
The video cuts back to Justin and Erik.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What an inspirational video! I'd give the directing a B-minus!
Erik pats himself on the back.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Justin, in thanks for all your hard work... I'm proud to present you this $500 gift certificate to the Centerscore Mall!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Thanks, but... I don't go to... Malls. We'll donate the gift card to the needy.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Wow! What a great guy!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Okay, folks. Show's over! Have a great day!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Five-hundred dollar... Gift card... Wasted!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: If we were still dating, that gift card would have been `mine!` I need my First Lady benefits back, ASAP!
nodes.text_bbcode: If we were still dating, that gift card would have been [color=#3b78e2][i]mine![/i][/color] I need my First Lady benefits back, ASAP!

nodes.text: Later that day, at lunch... Jessica sees Ben and Denni sitting together.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Smooch. That's 2,000 kisses!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Even though we're completely obnoxious, I have to admit that this is too much fun!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Blech.
Jessica pops another mint.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I can't believe he's sitting at that `loser` table today, just to suck face with Little Miss Purple-Hair!
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't believe he's sitting at that [color=#3b78e2][i]loser[/i][/color] table today, just to suck face with Little Miss Purple-Hair!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'll never be able to break them up if they're attached at the lips! Time to divide and conquer!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I need someone to get Denni out of here. Now.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm sending in...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ben? But he's only `kind of` cute! Not `super hot` like Phil or college guys!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ben? But he's only [color=#3b78e2][i]kind of[/i][/color] cute! Not [color=#3b78e2][i]super hot[/i][/color] like Phil or college guys!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Did our definition of `'hot'` change? Does 'hot' mean smart now?
nodes.text_bbcode: Did our definition of [color=#3b78e2][i]'hot'[/i][/color] change? Does 'hot' mean smart now?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hee hee! I'm so hot!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Shut up! All of you!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I just meant that he will be super hot...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Uh-huh...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: He will! Once I've broken up Ben and Denni, made Ben my boyfriend, and gotten him elected President...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Step one... Get rid of the dead weight.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You mean Denni?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Exactly. Step two. Make Ben my boyfriend.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Step three. Get him elected School President.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Step four. I get all of my First Lady fringe benefits back!
Jessica charges through the nerds, the cheerleaders in tight formation behind her!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Outta my way, dorks!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Whoa! Amazons!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: They must have Pom-Poms of Terrific Might!
A few seconds later, all the cheerleaders have crowded around Ben at his table...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uhh... Hi?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hi, Ben! We thought you could use some company!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You looked lonely!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I didn't melt!
A few moments later, Denni comes up to Ben...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hey, Mr. Popular, can you squeeze me in?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sure!
Ben tries to scoot over to make more room, but he's packed in too tight!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You don't always have to sit next to your boyfriend, you know?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Unless you `want` to be clingy!
nodes.text_bbcode: Unless you [color=#3b78e2][i]want[/i][/color] to be clingy!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No, why spend time with my boyfriend when he's got plenty of company?!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Where'd my pie go?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Where `did` it go?! I set it right there! Did anyone see where it went?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Where [color=#3b78e2][i]did[/i][/color] it go?! I set it right there! Did anyone see where it went?!

nodes.text: Nicole returns with Denni... At the same time, Ben comes in from the kitchen.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Denni! What are `you` doing here?
nodes.text_bbcode: Denni! What are [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] doing here?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Looks like you were wrong, Jess. Ben's been here the whole time!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And that means you get to eat whatever you want and be super thankful for that freedom!
Keith takes a quiet step in the direction of the pie...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Guys, this offer is good for a limited time only! Dig in!
The cheerleaders descend upon the pie, scarfing it up!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: It's better than in my dreams!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I've never cried tears of joy before!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I love this holiday!
A minute later, nothing is left of Denni's pie.
The cheerleaders stand firm!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Then I don't know what to do because I also have an order from you to `never` break the diet!
nodes.text_bbcode: Then I don't know what to do because I also have an order from you to [color=#3b78e2][i]never[/i][/color] break the diet!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Me too!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Although that pie smells how a warm cookie would smell if it were wrapped in cotton candy...
Jessica hears Denni and Nicole returning from upstairs!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Fine!
Jessica grabs the pie and hurls it out the window! Keith sinks to his knees!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: `Gah!` Why? What sense is there in a world where pie is wasted?!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Gah![/i][/color] Why? What sense is there in a world where pie is wasted?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I `tried` to be nice!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]tried[/i][/color] to be nice!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Well, after she went shopping, she ran into $ZOE, and they talked for a few minutes.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: It turns out, she's buying all that stuff so she can cook a romantic Thanksgiving meal for Ben!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's the opposite of breaking up!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Yeah... She's planning to surprise him with dinner at his house tomorrow at 6:00...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's perfect. In that case, we'll plan on throwing Ben a little party of our own... `Starting at 5:30!`
nodes.text_bbcode: That's perfect. In that case, we'll plan on throwing Ben a little party of our own... [color=#3b78e2][i]Starting at 5:30![/i][/color]

nodes.text: It's Thanksgiving Day!
At 5:30, Jessica and the rest of the cheerleaders are standing on Ben's porch! Jessica rings the doorbell.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I can't wait to see Ben's face when he sees us!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I'm supposed to be with my family!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Maria! Seriously, enough! All this family talk is really killing my Thanksgiving mood!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I love this time of year!
Ben opens the door!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whoa! What are you guys doing here?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: We heard you were alone, so we've come to cheer you up with a surprise Thanksgiving party!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Aww, wow! That's really thoughtful! Come on in!
About thirty minutes later, Denni steps onto the porch...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I can't wait to see Ben's face when he sees me!
She rings the doorbell. After a moment, Jessica opens the door.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Denni! Hi!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Jessica? What are `you` doing here?
nodes.text_bbcode: Jessica? What are [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] doing here?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You don't know?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: The girls felt really bad about Ben being alone and all, so they decided to throw him a surprise Thanksgiving party!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What?! But `I` was supposed to surprise him!
nodes.text_bbcode: What?! But [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] was supposed to surprise him!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh no! Did they accidentally ruin your plans?!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It looks that way...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm sorry! I don't think they even considered how you might feel about this.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Come in, and we'll get this sorted... Wait... What smells so good?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's either the tofu turkey or this pumpkin pie...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh, it's definitely the pie... Let me take that off your hands!
Jessica snatches the pie from Denni's hands!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Don't drop that! I slaved over it all day!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's important that I give it to Ben...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: This is my big chance! If Ben doesn't eat this pie, it'll break Denni!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: We'll totally get it right to him!
Jessica ushers Denni into the dining room.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Denni made it!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Hey, Denni!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Uh, can I speak to Ben?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sure! He's, uh, upstairs, `right, Nicole?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Sure! He's, uh, upstairs, [color=#3b78e2][i]right, Nicole?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Oh... Uh, yeah, I'll take you to him. Don't worry, Denni! No milkshakes this time!
Nicole leads Denni upstairs. As soon as they're out of earshot...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I thought Ben was in the kitchen!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Shhh! Every time you're going to speak, `don't!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Shhh! Every time you're going to speak, [color=#3b78e2][i]don't![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Besides, why would you talk when there's `pie` to be eaten?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Besides, why would you talk when there's [color=#3b78e2][i]pie[/i][/color] to be eaten?!

nodes.text: Jessica unveils Denni's pie!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Pie... Crust and yummy filling combining for perfect gastronomical harmony.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Wait... This is a trap! We're all supposed to be on a diet! Jessica's just testing us!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's not a test. It's...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Enough with the grocery list! Just skip to the good stuff!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Don't make me regret choosing you over Amanda...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ugh! What else?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Well, after the apple cider...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: She bought some mashed potatoes.
Twenty minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Then, she bought some ingredients for pumpkin pie.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: How long is this shopping trip?!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: It's almost over! I'm on page seven of the report, Denni's Shopping Cart Malfunction!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Grr!
Twenty more minutes...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: And then she paid with a credit card...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's it? That's the end of the report?! All she did was go grocery shopping?!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: There is one more thing...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm a journalist, Jessica... I know when a story doesn't have its facts straight...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What are you saying?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Come on... You've always been popular, haven't you?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No! Maybe my story `seems` far-fetched to you, but I'm trying to...
nodes.text_bbcode: No! Maybe my story [color=#3b78e2][i]seems[/i][/color] far-fetched to you, but I'm trying to...

nodes.text: Tears well up in Jessica's eyes...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm trying to relate to you, Denni.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's what happened!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Wait? He dumped you for someone `less` cool than you?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait? He dumped you for someone [color=#3b78e2][i]less[/i][/color] cool than you?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No! I mean... She was a loser `because` he chose her!
nodes.text_bbcode: No! I mean... She was a loser [color=#3b78e2][i]because[/i][/color] he chose her!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: She was really popular though!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Are you serious? That's horrible!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: For a...?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: A, uh, girl, who always wore shades on her head...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That sounds a lot like you.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It was really tragic, and... And...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: One day he, like, dumped me harshly for a...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: He'd do nice things all the time!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Like buy me stuff and say nice things about me!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Awww...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And this guy `wasn't` popular?
nodes.text_bbcode: And this guy [color=#3b78e2][i]wasn't[/i][/color] popular?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, he was hot, you know, on the inside.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: `You` were with a guy who had a... A hot personality?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]You[/i][/color] were with a guy who had a... A hot personality?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Uh-huh...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Way...?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Way, you know... Stuff.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Real knack for description there, Jessica...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Forget about that...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And everyone loved him because he was way...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Like a popular guy?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Er... He was a jock `and` a nerd!
nodes.text_bbcode: Er... He was a jock [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] a nerd!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: How is that possible?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: He was `really` good at badminton!
nodes.text_bbcode: He was [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] good at badminton!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: He was kinda how Ben used to be... Only even nerdier!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Wow!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: A super... What, hero?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah, he was a superhero!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Are you sure you're remembering him right?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Er... I mean he was into superheroes...
Jessica charges at the nerds, but they block her path!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Anyone crossing these plains must pay a fee of 100 gold to Erik the Erik!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's so I can start my own inn!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Grr! Get out of our way or else!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: That's battle talk!
Dex pelts Jessica with a muffin!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Don't you ever do that again!
He pelts her with another muffin!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Fine! Here!
Jessica takes a chocolate milk carton from a nearby table and hands it to Erik.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Elixir of Healing!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Whatevs! Move!
They step aside...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: `Someone's` chaotic-evil, and it isn't us!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Someone's[/i][/color] chaotic-evil, and it isn't us!

nodes.text: By the time the cheerleaders reach Ben, Denni is already sitting there!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What's going on?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ben was smiling at us, so we thought he wanted us to come sit with him!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I was?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Why were you smiling at them?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Thank goodness for Nicole!
All of the cheerleaders start taking seats around Ben.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Not that we wanted to be alone or anything...
Nicole squeezes in between Ben and Denni.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hey! Ben! Aren't you going to say something?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What do you want me to say?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Forget it!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Got it? Any comments or concerns about the task?
A couple of the cheerleaders raise their hands.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: None? Super!
The next day, Ben is walking into school when some of the cheerleaders pass him...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Nicknames make guys feel special.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Questions let a guy know that he's interesting...
At cheer practice that afternoon...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: All right, girls! Gather around me!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: As you all know, Thanksgiving is coming up soon...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'll bring my egg-basket!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh... And I found out that Ben is feeling really down because his father's going to be away...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Awww...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So, I think we should make him feel better!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Make him feel better? That seems suspiciously generous of you...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No talking from any former head cheerleaders!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: In fact, you're dismissed from practice!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: For what reason?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Taylor didn't do anything wrong!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: If Taylor and $ZOE are around, they'll see right through my plans!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Gosh, relax! It's for a new Thanksgiving project! Taylor, you and $ZOE can go down to the local soup kitchen and feed the homeless!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh... Who would want to do something like that?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That sounds really nice!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `Now!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Now![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Taylor and $ZOE leave practice.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Now that they're out of our hair, we can get back to cheering up Ben!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Tomorrow, I want the rest of you to...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No probs!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Wait... Why are you doing this for me? We're not exactly friends.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Isn't it obvious?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You're with Ben now! He's a rising star, and you're rising with him!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's only a matter of time before you'll be able to eat lunch with me at the Center Table!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I certainly wouldn't want to pass up that kind of opportunity...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Only a crazy person would!
Denni takes her lunch tray and storms out of the cafeteria!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Denni! Wait!
Ben tries to follow her, but Jessica stops him.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Don't worry, Ben, I'll handle this.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But she's my girlfriend...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Exactly, you're her `boy`friend, and what she's feeling right now... Is something `boys` just don't understand.
nodes.text_bbcode: Exactly, you're her [color=#3b78e2][i]boy[/i][/color]friend, and what she's feeling right now... Is something [color=#3b78e2][i]boys[/i][/color] just don't understand.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I've been with guys who are, like, suffocating because they wouldn't give me space when I needed it...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What did you do?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I dumped them! I had to just so I could breathe!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't want to suffocate Denni!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I know. Please, let me help you.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh... Okay. Thanks, Jessica...
Jessica finds Denni eating her lunch at a table on the school's front lawn...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Can I join you?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Sure...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I hate to say I told you so, but... Well, I told you so.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Wow! I feel a thousand times better!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sorry, but you have to hear this... Because it's only going to get worse!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It starts with innocent smiles in the hallway, a hello here, a hello there, then `everyone` wants a chance to sit next to Ben at lunch!
nodes.text_bbcode: It starts with innocent smiles in the hallway, a hello here, a hello there, then [color=#3b78e2][i]everyone[/i][/color] wants a chance to sit next to Ben at lunch!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Soon, all his time will be occupied by the affection of `other girls!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Soon, all his time will be occupied by the affection of [color=#3b78e2][i]other girls![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But Ben's not like that...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: He isn't? Where is he now? He saw how hurt you were... Why isn't he here now?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's cause he's a `guy,` Denni! And guys are interested in two things, `food and girls!` And both of those things can be found in the cafeteria...
nodes.text_bbcode: It's cause he's a [color=#3b78e2][i]guy,[/i][/color] Denni! And guys are interested in two things, [color=#3b78e2][i]food and girls![/i][/color] And both of those things can be found in the cafeteria...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Wait... What do `you` know about feeling insecure? You're one of them. Guys don't dump `you.` Guys dump girls like me `for` you!
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait... What do [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] know about feeling insecure? You're one of them. Guys don't dump [color=#3b78e2][i]you.[/i][/color] Guys dump girls like me [color=#3b78e2][i]for[/i][/color] you!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I wasn't always a cheerleader, you know?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You weren't? I always just assumed you were born with a set of pom-poms in your hands.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Actually, I `have` been popular since birth. But Denni doesn't have to know that...
nodes.text_bbcode: Actually, I [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] been popular since birth. But Denni doesn't have to know that...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Maybe I can make up a story to gain her trust!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: When I started at Centerscore, I really wanted to be popular! I started dating this guy...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: He was, like, a super...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh, hey, I'm sorry, Jessica...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's okay, `sniffle!`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's okay, [color=#3b78e2][i]sniffle![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I saw you were in a similar position to the one I was in... And I just wanted to reach out to you...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well, what do you think I should do?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `Sniffle!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Sniffle![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: If I were you, I'd dump Ben now, before he breaks your heart...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'll... I'll think about it.
Denni walks away... And after a few seconds, Nicole approaches Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: So, how'd it go? You break them up yet?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's what `you're` going to spend the next few hours finding out!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's what [color=#3b78e2][i]you're[/i][/color] going to spend the next few hours finding out!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Follow her everywhere she goes. I'll expect a full report.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I want to know what she eats, how she dyes her hair, and where she buys her ugly clothes.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: But I was going to a party at the MAN Frathouse!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's okay. `I'll` go to the party. You cling to Denni like her cheap, hipster perfume!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's okay. [color=#3b78e2][i]I'll[/i][/color] go to the party. You cling to Denni like her cheap, hipster perfume!

nodes.text: Later, at the MAN house...

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: ...Thanks again for coming! I can never remember what dorm you're in.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm in a lot of dorms.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Psst! Jessica!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What are you doing here?! You're supposed to be clinging to Denni!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I know... But I've got the full report you wanted!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh! Excellent. I was getting so bored. No offense, Dennis.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: But I'm not 'Dennis' I'm... Oh, never mind.
He turns and leaves.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Okay. Spill. What's the dirt? Did she leave him yet?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Well, first, Denni went to the store. She bought tofu, sprouts, soy sauce...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Boring, boring, boring. Next!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Uh... She also got some apple cider.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Grrr...

options.label: Make Nicole get to the point!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: But you...
Jessica shoots Maria a glare...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Ahem. I've got something in my throat.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's okay, Denni! There's always this pie on the table here. Jessica bought it from my favorite restaurant!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Cause buying it is `so` much more thoughtful than spending `all` day baking it!
nodes.text_bbcode: Cause buying it is [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] much more thoughtful than spending [color=#3b78e2][i]all[/i][/color] day baking it!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Are you upset?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No, I'm ecstatic to find all these cheerleaders here in your house!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Aww, don't fight, you guys! Why don't we calm down over a nice meal? It's dinner time!
A few minutes later, everyone is gathered around the dinner table.

Erik approaches Hawk...
Hello, Mr. Hawk, sir!
What? Oh, little camera guy, no one calls Hawk 'sir'. It's 'Hawk' or walk...
Sorry... Hawk.
I was wondering if you could sign my ski lift ticket. I've never met a celebrity before... Except my mailman once!

Hawk snowboards away...

I guess it helps to be blissfully naive...
